title: Rear Pressure Bulkhead Web — Crack Stop and Reinforcing Plate Repair at a Radial Segment
abstract: Interim repair for cracking in an outer radial segment of the rear pressure bulkhead web, using a stop drill and a reinforcing plate, valid for a limited life until a permanent solution is embodied.

sections.purpose: This repair arrests a crack in an outer radial segment of the rear pressure bulkhead web and restores the pressure boundary, for a limited period, until a permanent reinforcement is available for the aircraft.
sections.damage_assessment: Locate both crack tips by dye penetrant and confirm them by eddy current before you decide the stop drill positions. Measure the crack length along the web and record its distance from the circumferential joint and from the segment root. A crack longer than 40 millimetres, a crack that reaches the circumferential joint, or a crack in more than one segment on the same aircraft is outside the scope of this repair and requires an engineering assessment before further flight. Where the shear tie D5331135070611 at the segment root shows any indication, this repair may not be used. Record the segment number and the aircraft flight cycles at the time of the finding.
sections.repair_procedure: Get access to the forward face of the bulkhead with the rear cabin and the aft cargo compartment lining removed. Stop drill each crack tip with the diameter and the position given on repair drawing RD-53-31-13-903, and ream the hole to remove the drilling burr. Do a dye penetrant inspection of each stop hole and confirm that the crack tip has been fully removed. Where a tip has not been removed, move the stop hole outward by one increment and repeat. Cut the reinforcing plate from the stock given on sheet 1 and drill it using the layout template. Apply the chromate-free surface protection to all bare metal and to the stop holes. Position the plate over the cracked area with sealant on the faying surface and install the bolts EN330176-8B wet, using the barrel nuts AGS661650K8 on the aft face. Torque in the sequence on sheet 2. Apply a continuous sealant fillet around the plate perimeter and let it cure fully. Do a cabin pressurisation leak check before the aircraft returns to service.
sections.inspection_requirements: The repair is limited to 6000 flight cycles from the date of embodiment or to the embodiment of a permanent reinforcement, whichever occurs first. Do a repeat eddy current inspection around the plate perimeter and at each stop hole every 1500 flight cycles, together with a cabin leak check. Any crack growth beyond a stop hole invalidates the repair immediately and the aircraft must not be pressurised until an engineering assessment is available.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: A single crack up to 40 millimetres long in one outer radial segment, not reaching the circumferential joint and not closer than 25 millimetres to the segment root shear tie.

repair_drawings.title: Crack stop and reinforcing plate, bulkhead outer radial segment

type_data.fastener_pattern: Two concentric arcs of 16 bolts EN330176-8B, 25 mm pitch, 18 mm edge distance
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Interim repair limited to 6000 flight cycles or to the embodiment of a permanent reinforcement; repeat eddy current inspection and cabin leak check every 1500 flight cycles.
